The\n// assembler accepts AVX without -mavx2; the ops are plain vaddps/vsubps/vmulps\n// (no FMA), so results are bit-identical. vzeroupper hands back a clean upper\n// state to the surrounding SSE code (unless the TU itself is built with AVX).\n#if defined(__AVX__)\n#  define CEDAR_ARITH_VZEROUPPER \"\"\n#else\n#  define CEDAR_ARITH_VZEROUPPER \"vzeroupper\\n\\t\"\n#endif\n#define CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, off)                  \\\n    \"vmovaps \" #off \"(%[a]), %%ymm0\\n\\t\"             \\\n    insn \" \" #off \"(%[b]), %%ymm0, %%ymm0\\n\\t\"       \\\n    \"vmovaps %%ymm0, \" #off \"(%[o])\\n\\t\"\n#define CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK(insn)                                                          \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 0)   CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 32)  CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 64)   \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 96)  CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 128) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 160)  \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 192) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 224) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 256)  \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 288) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 320) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 352)  \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 384) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 416) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 448)  \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 480) CEDAR_ARITH_VZEROUPPER\nstatic_assert(BLOCK_SIZE == 128, \"CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK is unrolled for 128 floats\");\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]] inline void add_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    asm volatile(CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK(\"vaddps\")\n                 : : [a] \"r\"(a), [b] \"r\"(b), [o] \"r\"(out) : \"xmm0\", \"memory\");\n}\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]] inline void sub_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    // AT&T operand order: vsubps b, a, dst  ->  dst = a - b.\n    asm volatile(CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK(\"vsubps\")\n                 : : [a] \"r\"(a), [b] \"r\"(b), [o] \"r\"(out) : \"xmm0\", \"memory\");\n}\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]] inline void mul_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    asm volatile(CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK(\"vmulps\")\n                 : : [a] \"r\"(a), [b] \"r\"(b), [o] \"r\"(out) : \"xmm0\", \"memory\");\n}\n#undef CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK\n#undef CEDAR_ARITH_STEP\n#undef CEDAR_ARITH_VZEROUPPER\n#endif","originalFile":"#pragma once\n\n#include \"../vm/context.hpp\"\n#include \"../vm/instruction.hpp\"\n#include \"../dsp/constants.hpp\"\n#include \"../dsp/simd.hpp\"\n#include <cmath>\n\nnamespace cedar {\n\nnamespace kernels {\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n// Element-wise binary ops. Loops are fully\n// unrolled: 16 iterations of load/op/store are otherwise bound by loop overhead.\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 inline void add_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n#pragma GCC unroll 16\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8)\n        _mm256_store_ps(out + i, _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_load_ps(a + i), _mm256_load_ps(b + i)));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2 inline void mul_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n#pragma GCC unroll 16\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; (a[i] / b[i]) : 0.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// POW: out = in0 ^ in1\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_pow(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    const float* a = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n    const float* b = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[1]);\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        out[i] = std::pow(a[i], b[i]);\n    }\n}\n\n// NEG: out = -in0\n[[gnu::always_inline]]\ninline void op_neg(ExecutionContext& ctx, const Instruction& inst) {\n    float* out = ctx.buffers->get(inst.out_buffer);\n    const float* a = ctx.buffers->get(inst.inputs[0]);\n\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; ++i) {\n        out[i] = -a[i];\n    }\n}\n\n}  // namespace cedar\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":11,"oldLines":34,"newStart":11,"newLines":59,"lines":[" namespace kernels {"," #if CEDAR_SIMD_X86"," // Element-wise binary ops. The\n// assembler accepts AVX without -mavx2; the ops are plain vaddps/vsubps/vmulps\n// (no FMA), so results are bit-identical. vzeroupper hands back a clean upper\n// state to the surrounding SSE code (unless the TU itself is built with AVX).\n#if defined(__AVX__)\n#  define CEDAR_ARITH_VZEROUPPER \"\"\n#else\n#  define CEDAR_ARITH_VZEROUPPER \"vzeroupper\\n\\t\"\n#endif\n#define CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, off)                  \\\n    \"vmovaps \" #off \"(%[a]), %%ymm0\\n\\t\"             \\\n    insn \" \" #off \"(%[b]), %%ymm0, %%ymm0\\n\\t\"       \\\n    \"vmovaps %%ymm0, \" #off \"(%[o])\\n\\t\"\n#define CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK(insn)                                                          \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 0)   CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 32)  CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 64)   \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 96)  CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 128) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 160)  \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 192) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 224) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 256)  \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 288) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 320) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 352)  \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 384) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 416) CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 448)  \\\n    CEDAR_ARITH_STEP(insn, 480) CEDAR_ARITH_VZEROUPPER\nstatic_assert(BLOCK_SIZE == 128, \"CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK is unrolled for 128 floats\");\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]] inline void add_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    asm volatile(CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK(\"vaddps\")\n                 : : [a] \"r\"(a), [b] \"r\"(b), [o] \"r\"(out) : \"xmm0\", \"memory\");\n}\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]] inline void sub_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    // AT&T operand order: vsubps b, a, dst  ->  dst = a - b.\n    asm volatile(CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK(\"vsubps\")\n                 : : [a] \"r\"(a), [b] \"r\"(b), [o] \"r\"(out) : \"xmm0\", \"memory\");\n}\n\n[[gnu::always_inline]] inline void mul_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    asm volatile(CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK(\"vmulps\")\n                 : : [a] \"r\"(a), [b] \"r\"(b), [o] \"r\"(out) : \"xmm0\", \"memory\");\n}\n#undef CEDAR_ARITH_BLOCK\n#undef CEDAR_ARITH_STEP\n#undef CEDAR_ARITH_VZEROUPPER\n#endif","new_string":"// stored, so in-place use (out == a or out == b) is safe.\n//\n// The output block is 8 cache lines; when it is not L1-resident each store\n// needs an RFO, and the store buffer would otherwise wait on them one line\n// at a time. prefetchw on all 8 lines up front overlaps those RFOs with the\n// loads and arithmetic. (prfchw ships on every AVX2 CPU; it's a hint only.)\n#define CEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW [[gnu::target(\"avx2,prfchw\")]]\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW inline void prefetch_block_for_write(float* out) noexcept {\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 16) _m_prefetchw(out + i);\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW inline void add_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    prefetch_block_for_write(out);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8)\n        _mm256_store_ps(out + i, _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_load_ps(a + i), _mm256_load_ps(b + i)));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW inline void mul_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    prefetch_block_for_write(out);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; (prfchw ships on every AVX2 CPU; it's a hint only.)\n#define CEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW [[gnu::target(\"avx2,prfchw\")]]\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW inline void prefetch_block_for_write(float* out) noexcept {\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 16) _m_prefetchw(out + i);\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW inline void add_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    prefetch_block_for_write(out);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8)\n        _mm256_store_ps(out + i, _mm256_add_ps(_mm256_load_ps(a + i), _mm256_load_ps(b + i)));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW inline void sub_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    prefetch_block_for_write(out);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8)\n        _mm256_store_ps(out + i, _mm256_sub_ps(_mm256_load_ps(a + i), _mm256_load_ps(b + i)));\n}\n\nCEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW inline void mul_avx2(const float* a, const float* b, float* out) noexcept {\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(a, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(b, 32);\n    CEDAR_SIMD_ASSERT_ALIGNED(out, 32);\n    prefetch_block_for_write(out);\n    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < BLOCK_SIZE; i += 8)\n        _mm256_store_ps(out + i, _mm256_mul_ps(_mm256_load_ps(a + i), _mm256_load_ps(b + i)));\n}\n#undef CEDAR_TARGET_AVX2_PRFCHW\n#endif","originalFile":"#pragma once\n\n#include \"../vm/context.hpp\"\n#include \"../vm/instruction.hpp\"\n#include \"../dsp/constants.hpp\"\n#include \"../dsp/simd.hpp\"\n#include <cmath>\n\nnamespace cedar {\n\nnamespace kernels {\n#if CEDAR_SIMD_X86\n// Element-wise binary ops. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfQXes52CKWUnsBVebrR9","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The short benchmark shows all three opcodes about 8% faster than the current version, and output is still bit-identical on the fixed stimuli:\n\n| Opcode | Current | Now | Speedup |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `op_add` | 11.17 ns | 10.35 ns | 1.08x |\n| `op_sub` | 11.33 ns | 10.48 ns | 1.08x |\n| `op_mul` | 11.19 ns | 10.24 ns | 1.09x |\n\nThe hidden stimuli, unit test suites and the longer 5-round benchmark only run at the final verify, so those haven't been checked yet. I used 3 of the 10 check runs.\n\n**What limits these opcodes:** it isn't the arithmetic. The benchmark writes 64 outputs spaced 1 KB apart, which puts them in only half of the L1 cache sets. That's about 16 lines per set against 12 ways, so each output block's 8 cache lines keep getting evicted. Every store then has to fetch its line from L2 first.\n\n**The change** (`cedar/include/cedar/opcodes/arithmetic.hpp`): each AVX2 kernel now issues a `prefetchw` on all 8 output lines before its load/op/store loop. The fetches from L2 then overlap with the loads and arithmetic instead of blocking the stores one line at a time. The kernels carry `[[gnu::target(\"avx2,prfchw\")]]`. `prefetchw` is only a hint and doesn't change results, so output stays bit-identical. The scalar bodies are unchanged.\n\n**Tried and dropped:**\n- **Fully unrolling the loop:** 1.00x, so loop overhead isn't the bottleneck.\n- **Inline-asm kernels to remove the out-of-line call:** 0.95–0.99x, slower, so the call isn't the bottleneck either.\n\n**Stray file for you to delete:** I accidentally created `cedar/include/cedar/opcodes/arithmetic.hpp.new` and my tools can't delete files. I emptied it, and the allowlist accepted it, but it's junk.
